Subject: Order Form: EWS-420 - subprocessor chain & DPA evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing the order form for EWS-420 and Legal on our side flagged the subcontractor / downstream flow-down language. Before we countersign we need a short audit exercise: a list of any downstream processors that will handle customer data for this engagement, the contract/flow-down clause that applies to each, and any recent evidence (SOC2 report or equivalent attestation).

Can you send: 1) the proposed order form redline you intend to countersign; 2) the list of downstream processors and brief description of their access; 3) any DPA addenda or vendor attestations? We're trying to close by end of week.

Thanks,
Andrew Collins
Head of Procurement
EdgeWave Systems

Hi Andrew — thanks for the note. Looping in Jordan (Legal) and Marissa (Procurement ops) to confirm the redline and gather evidence.

Quick answers up front:
- We'll attach our working order form redline (with the flow-down language we propose).
- Current downstream vendor that could touch customer data for logging/ingest is DataStream LLC (subcontracted for telemetry ingestion). We'll provide the short matrix (role, data access, location, legal basis).
- We'll surface the latest SOC2 attestation and a DPA addendum if required by your counsel.

Two asks for you so we can prioritize: 1) which data categories are EdgeWave most concerned about (PII, telemetry, audio transcripts, etc.)? 2) Is EdgeWave expecting full contract flow-down (i.e., vendor accedes to customer's DPA language) or is a binding written assurance + attestation sufficient?

We aim to get the packet to you within 48 hours.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Procurement (Redwood Inference)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Andrew Collins <andrew.collins@edgewave.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form: EWS-420 - subprocessor chain & DPA evidence request

Kimberly / Andrew — attaching the legal comments I recommend for the order form and the DPA annex. Key suggested edits: add explicit flow-down clause requiring downstream processors to be bound by the same data restrictions; require prior notice + 10 business day cure window for any new subcontractor; include right-to-audit language limited to evidence review (attestations, SOC2) rather than full onsite audits unless escalated.

I'm also proposing the following language snippet to add to the Order Form: 

"Subcontractors. Redwood may engage subcontractors to perform parts of the Services. Redwood shall ensure that any subcontractor handling Customer Personal Data is bound by a written agreement that imposes obligations at least as protective as those set forth in the DPA. Redwood shall provide Customer with a written list of subcontractors that will have access to Customer Personal Data and copies of applicable attestations upon Customer's request."

I've included a short vendor-delegation matrix export with roles and last-attestation dates.

—Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Contracts
[Attachment: legal_redline_EWS420.docx (docx)]

From: Andrew Collins <andrew.collins@edgewave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgewave.com, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form: EWS-420 - subprocessor chain & DPA evidence request

Thanks Jordan — that language looks reasonable. For our internal risk team a couple of clarifications:
1) DataStream LLC will be the only vendor potentially ingesting telemetry that contains customer-identified metadata; they are a US company and will process data in the US.
2) We prefer a contractual flow-down (i.e., vendor obligations flow to the subcontractor). If a binding flow-down is not feasible, a written assurance + evidence will suffice but may push the approval timeline.

I've attached DataStream's current SOC2 attestation and a short vendor statement. We're prepared to accept the 10 business day notice/cure proposal.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce the vendor agreement with DataStream for our review (redacted where needed) and whether you can provide the DPA addendum for signatures? Also please send the DocuSign link when the order form is ready.

Regards,
Andrew

[Attachment: DataStream_SOC2_Attestation.pdf (pdf); Attachment: DataStream_vendor_statement.docx (docx)]

- We'll provide a redacted DataStream subcontract (SOW + data handling addendum) for your review by EOD Friday (24 Jul) — if we need more time we'll push to Monday but will flag it.
- We'll include the vendor-delegation-matrix CSV with last-attestation dates (attached).
- I'll generate the DocuSign envelope once legal confirms the final order form; estimated DocuSign send: Friday evening.
